It was first published in the December 2023 issue of ''[[Ciao]]'', released on November 2, 2023.<ref>[http://web.archive.org/web/20231102184348/https://www.shogakukan.co.jp/magazines/0613912123 ''Ciao'' December 2023 issue | Shogakukan] (Japanese; archived)</ref><ref>[https://twitter.com/kise_ricca/status/1719997114175180845 Ricca Kise on Twitter] (Japanese)</ref> It is eight pages long.
